digest.component_or_area: pytest editor fixture instrumentation and ThreadingHTTPServer setup timing
propositions: CPython ThreadingHTTPServer constructor synchronously calls socket.getfqdn on numeric 127.0.0.1, triggering macOS reverse-DNS timeout and causing ~35-second recurring delay in test_server_binds_loopback_only
Focused editor test setup completes in subsecond to 2.44s and targeted instrumentation showed <4ms, but Gerrit Verify runs consistently show 35.06–35.09s aggregate _server fixture setup duration

Organic post-merge observability confirmed socket.getfqdn elapsed=35.013s and ThreadingHTTPServer constructor elapsed=35.014s on macOS, ruling out TCP bind, tmp_path, and worker starvation as root causes

Instrumentation must measure nested fixture spans (constructor, bind, getfqdn) above 1-second threshold only when CI environment variable or REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 is set, without changing test semantics or behavior
Deterministic tests prove timing observer correctly attributes worker, node, fixture, and elapsed seconds; mutation proof shows threshold sensitivity and no emission below 1.0s
